subject: Oceanography
title: The Pacific Ocean
description: A 60-second lesson on The Pacific Ocean.

hook.text: The Pacific is so large it holds more water than all other oceans combined.

buildup.text: Magellan named it 'Pacific' (peaceful) in 1521—after surviving brutal Atlantic storms.

discovery.text: It spans 165 million square kilometers—wider than the Moon's entire surface area.

twist.text: Despite its name, the Pacific hosts Earth's most violent typhoons and tsunamis.

climax.text: The Ring of Fire lines its edges—90% of the world's earthquakes happen there.

punchline.text: Peaceful in name only—the Pacific is Earth's wildest ocean.

quiz.question: What percentage of the world's earthquakes occur along the Ring of Fire?
